name: webml-community/lfm3-1.7b-webgpu-pi
title: Pi coding agent runs LFM3-1.7B fully in the browser over WebGPU
summary: Xenova published a Hugging Face Space that runs the Pi agent harness with Liquid's LFM3-1.7B locally in the browser. It uses custom WebGPU kernels and a 4-bit GGUF, and reports over 300 tok/s on an M4 Max. Nothing leaves the machine. Liquid's own card says the 1.7B model is not recommended for complex agentic coding, so treat this as a local-agent runtime demo, not a coding-quality claim.
